question: By what factor did molecular distillation raise the α-terpineol percentage of the light fraction over the niaouli oil residue?
rendered:
According to the document, the niaouli oil residue (NOR) contained 36.52% a-terpineol, while the light fraction (LF) contained 66.10% a-terpineol after molecular distillation. 

To calculate the factor by which molecular distillation raised the a-terpineol percentage, divide the a-terpineol percentage of the LF by the a-terpineol percentage of the NOR: 

66.10 / 36.52 ≈ 1.81
